question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Words that begin with the same letter, syllable or sound
solution:
The correct answer is '**Alliteration**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Alliteration**'.
 
• **Alliteration** - समानाधिकारी (samaanaadhikaari)
 
• Meaning in English: The occurrence of the same letter or sound at the beginning of adjacent or closely connected words. 
 
 
• *Example: **P**eter **P**iper picked a **p**eck of** p**ickled **p**eppers. This sentence uses alliteration by repeating the "**p**" sound at the beginning of several words.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Alliteration.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Metaphor** - रूपक (roopak). Meaning in English: A figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.
 
• **Pun** - मज़ाकिया उलझन (mazaakiya uljhan). Meaning in English: A play on words that uses multiple meanings of a word or words that.
 
• **Hyperbole** - अतिशयोक्ति (atishayokti). Meaning in English: An exaggeration used for emphasis or effect.
